#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}

df[df$Measure == "Unique",]$Measure <- "Pass"

### Calculate Percent Loss

```{r}
percent_loss_data <- data.frame(Process = character(),
                                Measure = character(),
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Iterate over rows and calculate Percent-loss
for (i in 2:nrow(df)) {
    if (df$Measure[i] == "Fail") {
        percent_loss_values <- as.numeric(df[i, 3:ncol(df)]) / as.numeric(df[(i - 1), 3:ncol(df)]) * 100
        
        # Create a new row in the percent_loss_data data frame
        new_row <- data.frame(Process = df$Process[i],
                              Measure = df$Measure[i],
                              Percent_loss = percent_loss_values,
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        
        # Bind the new row to the percent_loss_data data frame
        percent_loss_data <- rbind(percent_loss_data, new_row)
    }
}

# Print the result
print(percent_loss_data)
```

```{r}
percent_loss <- function(data){
    # Initialize a new data frame to store Percent-loss values and associated columns
    percent_loss_data <- data.frame(Process = character(),
                                    Measure = character(),
                                    Column = character(),
                                    Percent_loss = numeric(),
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Iterate over rows and calculate Percent-loss
    for (i in 2:nrow(data)) {
      if (data$Measure[i] == "Fail") {
        percent_loss_values <- as.numeric(data[i, 3:8]) / as.numeric(data[(i - 1), 3:8]) * 100
        
        # Create a new row in the percent_loss_data data frame
        new_row <- data.frame(Process = data$Process[i],
                              Measure = data$Measure[i],
                              Column = colnames(data)[3:8],
                              Percent_loss = percent_loss_values,
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        
        # Bind the new row to the percent_loss_data data frame
        percent_loss_data <- rbind(percent_loss_data, new_row)
      }
    }
    
    # Print the result
    print(percent_loss_data)
}

```
